info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Chemical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程探討以流體力學為中心的工程問題。課程的目的在培養研究生使用數學模型去了解，描述及設計工程系統中關於流體力學的問題。課程內容將涵蓋流體運動方程式的基礎計算 (質量守恆方程式、動量守恆方程式、能量守恆方程式)，試用軟體(COMSOL)進行複雜流場(截面積擴增、截面積縮小、階梯與死角)的流體運動計算，以及高分子流體(剪切稀化流體、剪切稠化流體，黏彈性流體)的流動相關計算。
description.describe_eh: This course is to examine problems in which?fluid mechanics is the central physical phenomena. The purpose of this course is to enable graduate students to use mathematic models to understand, describe and design engineering systems and processes that involve the mechanics and dynamics of fluids. The major topics of this course include the application of the equation of the motion in flow fields, using the computer software in calculating complicated flow phenomena, and the fluid mechanics for polymeric fluids.

targets.describe_en: Gain an understanding of the concepts of vectors and tensors

targets.describe_ch: 了解流體在工程上的應用與計算
targets.describe_en: Develop the ability to apply and compute fluid behavior in various engineering contexts
The diverse applications of fluid mechanics across various fields

textBooks.tpb_book: •Bird, R. B., Stewart, W. E., and Lightfoot, E. N., ‘Transport Phenomena’, John Wiley & Sons, Revised Second Edition, 2007 (BSL).

readings.tpc_book:
•Welty, J., Rorrer, G. L., & Foster, D. G. (2014). Fundamentals of momentum, heat, and mass transfer. John Wiley & Sons.
•Slattery, J. C. (1999). Advanced transport phenomena. Cambridge University Press.
•Aris, R. (2012). Vectors, tensors and the basic equations of fluid mechanics. Courier Corporation.
